name: Abano
notes:
Small beach north of Guincho. Initial exposure settings need observations at the actual lesson area.
2026-09-07 local review: Apply modest N/NW wind exposure and earlier experience escalation in the small bay. Retain Guincho-like low-mid tide response. Numerical settings remain provisional.

name: Adraga
notes:
Open Atlantic exposure, cliffs and rocks. Mid-tide weighting is an initial assumption, not a measured calibration.
2026-09-07 local review: Record sand-and-rock hazards and require more experience earlier as size or period rises. Retain the broad mid-tide preference and west-coast exposure. Numerical settings remain provisional.

sources.note: Sand and rock, consistent lefts and changing A-frame banks; favourable W swell and E wind.
sources.title: Ericeira Surf House: Adraga

sources.note: Official beach description identifies scattered rocks and surrounding cliffs.
sources.title: Visit Sintra: Adraga

name: Carcavelos
notes:
South-southwest exposure. North winds are offshore; banks and crowding change which part of the beach works.
2026-09-07 local review: Retain mid-high tide and W/SW plus large NW swell response. Reduce landward swell leakage and require more experience for longer-period or more powerful surf. Numerical settings remain provisional.

name: Praia da Cornélia · Caparica
notes:
Southern part of Praia da Saúde, known as Cornélia. Initial settings represent a sandy west-facing beach and need local observations.
2026-09-07 local review: Broaden the mid-tide sandbank window modestly and use matching experience thresholds for both Caparica beaches. Preserve their shared offshore data and modest existing local exposure differences. Numerical settings remain provisional.

sources.note: Sandbanks, seasonal swell and shelter vary along the coast. Shared offshore sampling for neighbouring beaches is retained.
sources.title: Gecko Surf School: Costa da Caparica guide

name: Cresmina
notes:
Nearby Guincho conditions provide the initial reference. Local shelter and sandbanks still need calibration.
2026-09-07 local review: Apply modest N/NW wind exposure and earlier experience escalation; retain low-mid tide. Record the mixed sand-and-rock bottom. Numerical settings remain provisional.

sources.note: Describes sand and rock, W/SW swell and E/SE wind. Exact coefficients are inferred.
sources.title: Ericeira Surf House: Cresmina

name: Guincho
notes:
Exposed beach with strong local wind effects. Mid to low tide is an initial preference; sandbanks vary.
2026-09-07 local review: Model stronger N/NW wind exposure without amplifying easterly offshore wind equally. Retain low-mid tide and open-Atlantic swell exposure. Numerical settings remain provisional.

name: Magoito
notes:
Exposed coast beneath cliffs. Initial wave and tide settings require local calibration.
2026-09-07 local review: Record mixed sand and reef. Keep small surf accessible to beginners but escalate powerful or long-period conditions earlier; retain NW exposure. Numerical settings remain provisional.

sources.note: Local school uses Magoito for summer lessons across experience levels.
sources.title: Lisbon Wave School: lessons

sources.note: Describes reef sections, playful summer surf and powerful NW-swell winter rights. Does not provide measured transfer coefficients.
sources.title: Surf Atlas: first-hand Magoito guide

name: Parede
notes:
Point break with a rocky bottom and potentially long paddle. Initial preference is mid tide.
2026-09-07 local review: Keep the mid-tide reef window, strengthen penalties at tidal extremes and reduce exposure to swell arriving from behind the coast. Intermediate remains the minimum level. Numerical settings remain provisional.

name: Praia da Torre
notes: Sheltered sandy bay east of Forte de São Julião da Barra. More dependent on larger incoming swell than neighbouring Carcavelos. Initial coefficients from qualitative local guidance; tide range and transfer factors need observed-session validation.

sources.note: Primary industry source describes a small, sheltered winter refuge where waves refract during larger swell. No exact transfer coefficients are published.
sources.title: Portuguese Surf Schools Association: Praia da Torre

sources.note: Map location 38.6757,-9.3228 verified in Chrome on 2026-09-07. Used as a one-time qualitative comparison, not a forecast feed.

name: Praia das Maçãs
notes:
Beach at the river mouth. Sandbanks and local currents can change; initial settings need instructor observations.
2026-09-07 local review: Use a broader tide window for changing sandbanks instead of a sharply preferred single tide stage. Escalate experience with size and period. Numerical settings remain provisional.

sources.note: Local operator describes exposed beach breaks and changing sandbanks; precise tide coefficients are not provided.

name: Praia Grande
notes:
Exposed Atlantic beach. Mid tide is an initial preference; conditions depend on sandbanks. Northern-wind shelter varies along the beach.
2026-09-07 local review: Replace abrupt north-wind sector boundaries with a continuous shelter curve. Preserve exposed swell response; escalate experience earlier for powerful surf. Numerical settings remain provisional.

sources.note: Local operator describes exposed beach breaks and changing sandbanks; precise tide coefficients are not provided.

name: Praia Pequena
notes:
Smaller beach north of Praia Grande, with some northern-wind shelter. Observe the banks and rocks before a lesson.
2026-09-07 local review: Smooth north-wind shelter without a sudden boundary. Retain the gentler local swell gain relative to Praia Grande. Numerical settings remain provisional.

sources.note: Local operator describes exposed beach breaks and changing sandbanks; precise tide coefficients are not provided.

name: Praia de São João · Caparica
notes:
Sandy beach near the Tagus mouth. Banks, currents and shelter vary along the beach; mid-tide preference is provisional.
2026-09-07 local review: Broaden the mid-tide sandbank window modestly and use matching experience thresholds for both Caparica beaches. Preserve their shared offshore data and modest existing local exposure differences. Numerical settings remain provisional.

name: São Julião
notes:
Open-coast beach at the Sintra and Mafra boundary. Initial settings need confirmation for the selected banks.
2026-09-07 local review: Extend the preferred window towards low tide, consistent with local beginner lessons, while retaining mid tide and open-Atlantic exposure. Numerical settings remain provisional.

sources.note: Local operator teaches beginners around low tide and more experienced surfers around mid tide. Numerical ratio 0–0.7 is an estimate.

name: São Pedro do Estoril · Bafureira
notes:
Local guidance: favours mid to high tide with higher swell. Published school guidance also identifies mid tide. Rocky bottom. West and south-west swell preferred. WNW swell around 280–283° can still produce small rideable surf; shelter increases sharply towards 290°. Local tuning based on owner knowledge and forecast comparison, pending measured beach observations.
2026-09-07 local review: Increase tide sensitivity and move powerful surf to Advanced earlier. Retain mid-high tide, larger-swell requirement and the established direction curve. Numerical settings remain provisional.

sources.note: Bico: low tide, mid tide with bigger swell. Bafureira: mid-high tide with higher swell.
sources.title: Owner observations, 5 September 2026

sources.note: São Pedro is strongly direction-dependent; useful swell around 272°, marginal near 282–283°, usually flat above 290°. Initial curve is a local observation, not a verified universal cutoff. GFS bearings are retained as supplied.
sources.title: Owner comparison with Surfline, 5 September 2026

name: São Pedro do Estoril · Bico
